description: The policy gate's verdict on one tool call, published for EVERY call the gate judged — allowed ones included — so a watcher can show 'policy allowed write_file' rather than only the refusals, which would read as 'nothing was checked' for the rest (P31). `verdict` is allowed | denied | asked; `reason` is the one formatter's sentence, verbatim. Absent entirely when a step runs with no gate. Arrives after `step.tool.start` and before the call's `step.tool.end`, paired by `toolUseId`.

payload.reason: allowed: agent:surveyor · "survey-writes" · target all-agents · source operator · no expiry
